tools.name: search_library
tools.description: Search Fireside Folio's free catalogue: classic and open-licence books, children's picture books, comics, magazines, puzzle books (sudoku, mazes, crosswords-style puzzles, calcudoku…), printable templates, planners and handwriting or maths practice sheets. Returns an id for each item.

tools.name: search_encyclopedia
tools.description: Search Wikipedia and the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica for articles to read on an e-reader. Returns each article's source and title.

tools.name: todays_wikipedia
tools.description: Wikipedia's featured article of the day and its 'On this day' events.

tools.name: find_news_sources
tools.description: Search the blogs, newsletters and news sites a reader can add to their Daily reads edition. Returns an id for each source.

tools.name: search_museum
tools.description: Search hundreds of thousands of public-domain artworks from The Met, the Art Institute of Chicago, the National Gallery of Art, the Rijksmuseum, the Cleveland Museum of Art and SMK (Denmark): paintings, prints, drawings, photographs, maps, manuscripts, sculpture and more. tools.name: send_museum_pieces
tools.description: Send one to 30 artworks (by their museum refs) to the reader's e-reader as full-page pictures. With a booklet title, they arrive as an exhibition booklet with a contents page and credits.

tools.name: get_my_fireside
tools.description: The signed-in reader's connected devices and Daily reads setup (schedule, subscriptions, saved links, queued topics, last edition).

tools.name: send_to_my_device
tools.description: Send a book, children's book, comic, magazine, puzzle book or template (by its catalogue id) to the reader's e-reader. Only free, openly licensed items exist; nothing is purchased.

tools.name: save_for_later
tools.description: Save a public web page (an article or blog post) to read later. It arrives in the reader's next Daily reads edition — or straight away with now=true.

tools.name: add_reading_topics
tools.description: Add encyclopedia articles (Wikipedia or 1911 Britannica, by title) to the reader's Daily reads; a few arrive in each edition.

tools.name: send_encyclopedia_articles
tools.description: Send up to 20 encyclopedia articles (Wikipedia or 1911 Britannica, by title) to the reader's e-reader right away, as one small book.

tools.name: subscribe_to_news_source
tools.description: Add (or remove) a blog or news site, by its id, in the reader's Daily reads edition.

tools.name: send_daily_edition_now
tools.description: Put together the reader's Daily reads edition now (new articles, saved links, newsletters, topics) and send it to their device. Takes a few minutes to arrive.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: save_for_later · Public sink: send_museum_pieces, send_to_my_device, save_for_later, send_encyclopedia_articles, send_daily_edition_now · Destructive: subscribe_to_news_source.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: save_for_later · Public sink: send_museum_pieces, send_to_my_device, save_for_later, send_encyclopedia_articles, send_daily_edition_now · Destructive: subscribe_to_news_source

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
